## Simulation and visualization of different distributions

### Gamma distribution

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function gammaFn(z) {
  const g = 7;
  const p = [0.99999999999980993, 676.5203681218851, -1259.1392167224028,
    771.32342877765313, -176.61502916214059, 12.507343278686905,
    -0.13857109526572012, 9.9843695780195716e-6, 1.5056327351493116e-7];
  if (z < 0.5) {
    return Math.PI / (Math.sin(Math.PI * z) * gammaFn(1 - z));
  }
  z -= 1;
  let x = p[0];
  for (let i = 1; i < g + 2; i++) x += p[i] / (z + i);
  const t = z + g + 0.5;
  return Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI) * Math.pow(t, z + 0.5) * Math.exp(-t) * x;
}

function gammaLn(z) {
  return Math.log(gammaFn(z));
}

function randomNormal() {
  let u = 0, v = 0;
  while (u === 0) u = Math.random();
  while (v === 0) v = Math.random();
  return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v);
}

// Marsaglia-Tsang: replaces R's rgamma()
function sampleGamma(shape, scale) {
  if (shape < 1) {
    const u = Math.random();
    return sampleGamma(shape + 1, scale) * Math.pow(u, 1 / shape);
  }
  const d = shape - 1 / 3;
  const c = 1 / Math.sqrt(9 * d);
  while (true) {
    let x, v;
    do {
      x = randomNormal();
      v = 1 + c * x;
    } while (v <= 0);
    v = v * v * v;
    const u = Math.random();
    if (u < 1 - 0.0331 * x * x * x * x) return d * v * scale;
    if (Math.log(u) < 0.5 * x * x + d * (1 - v + Math.log(v))) return d * v * scale;
  }
}

function gammaPDF(x, shape, scale) {
  if (x <= 0) return 0;
  return Math.pow(x, shape - 1) * Math.exp(-x / scale) /
    (gammaFn(shape) * Math.pow(scale, shape));
}

// Regularized lower incomplete gamma function, P(a, x) — replaces R's pgamma()
function lowerIncompleteGammaRegularized(a, x) {
  if (x <= 0 || a <= 0) return 0;
  if (x < a + 1) {
    // series representation
    let sum = 1 / a;
    let term = sum;
    let n = a;
    for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
      n += 1;
      term *= x / n;
      sum += term;
      if (Math.abs(term) < Math.abs(sum) * 1e-12) break;
    }
    return sum * Math.exp(-x + a * Math.log(x) - gammaLn(a));
  } else {
    // continued fraction representation for Q(a,x) = 1 - P(a,x)
    let b = x + 1 - a;
    let c = 1e30;
    let d = 1 / b;
    let h = d;
    for (let i = 1; i <= 200; i++) {
      const an = -i * (i - a);
      b += 2;
      d = an * d + b;
      if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-30) d = 1e-30;
      c = b + an / c;
      if (Math.abs(c) < 1e-30) c = 1e-30;
      d = 1 / d;
      const del = d * c;
      h *= del;
      if (Math.abs(del - 1) < 1e-12) break;
    }
    const Q = Math.exp(-x + a * Math.log(x) - gammaLn(a)) * h;
    return 1 - Q;
  }
}

function gammaCDF(x, shape, scale) {
  if (x <= 0) return 0;
  return lowerIncompleteGammaRegularized(shape, x / scale);
}

// Beta sampling via two gamma draws: replaces R's rbeta()
function sampleBeta(a, b) {
  const x = sampleGamma(a, 1);
  const y = sampleGamma(b, 1);
  return x / (x + y);
}

function betaPDF(x, a, b) {
  if (x <= 0 || x >= 1) return 0;
  const logB = gammaLn(a) + gammaLn(b) - gammaLn(a + b);
  return Math.exp((a - 1) * Math.log(x) + (b - 1) * Math.log(1 - x) - logB);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof parameterization = Inputs.radio(
  ["scale", "rate"],
  {value: "scale", label: "Parameterization",
   format: d => d === "scale" ? "Shape, Scale" : "Shape, Rate"}
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof shape = Inputs.range([0.1, 20], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Shape"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof second = Inputs.range(
  [0.1, 10],
  {value: 3, step: 0.1, label: parameterization === "scale" ? "Scale" : "Rate"}
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof resampleGamma = Inputs.button("Generate new draw")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
gammaScaleValue = parameterization === "scale" ? second : 1 / second
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
gammaSim = {
  resampleGamma;
  return {
    shape,
    scale: gammaScaleValue,
    draws: Array.from({length: 1000}, () => sampleGamma(shape, gammaScaleValue))
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
gammaXmax = Math.max(d3.max(gammaSim.draws) * 1.05, gammaSim.shape * gammaSim.scale * 3)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
gammaHistogram = {
  const bin = d3.bin().domain([0, gammaXmax]).thresholds(30);
  const bins = bin(gammaSim.draws);
  const n = gammaSim.draws.length;
  return bins.map(b => ({
    x1: b.x0,
    x2: b.x1,
    density: b.length / (n * (b.x1 - b.x0))
  }));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
gammaPdfPoints = {
  const xs = d3.range(gammaXmax / 10000, gammaXmax, gammaXmax / 300);
  return xs.map(x => ({x, y: gammaPDF(x, gammaSim.shape, gammaSim.scale)}));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
gammaCdfPoints = {
  const xs = d3.range(0, gammaXmax, gammaXmax / 300);
  return xs.map(x => ({x, y: gammaCDF(x, gammaSim.shape, gammaSim.scale)}));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import {Plot} from "@observablehq/plot"

Plot.plot({
  width: 640,
  height: 320,
  marginLeft: 50,
  title: `Gamma: shape = ${gammaSim.shape.toFixed(2)}, scale = ${gammaSim.scale.toFixed(2)}`,
  x: {label: "x", domain: [0, gammaXmax]},
  y: {label: "Density"},
  marks: [
    Plot.rect(gammaHistogram, {x1: "x1", x2: "x2", y1: 0, y2: "density", fill: "#BCD4E6"}),
    Plot.line(gammaPdfPoints, {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: "#C0392B", strokeWidth: 2})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  width: 640,
  height: 280,
  marginLeft: 50,
  title: "Cumulative distribution function",
  x: {label: "x", domain: [0, gammaXmax]},
  y: {label: "P(X ≤ x)", domain: [0, 1]},
  marks: [
    Plot.line(gammaCdfPoints, {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: "#4472C4", strokeWidth: 2})
  ]
})
```

### Dirichlet distribution

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof alpha = Inputs.range([0.01, 20], {value: 1, step: 0.01, label: "Concentration parameter"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof nComponents = Inputs.range([2, 10], {value: 3, step: 1, label: "Number of components"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof resampleDirichlet = Inputs.button("Generate new draw")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
dirichletWeights = {
  resampleDirichlet;
  const draws = Array.from({length: nComponents}, () => sampleGamma(alpha, 1));
  const total = d3.sum(draws);
  return draws.map((g, i) => ({component: `Component ${i + 1}`, weight: g / total}));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  width: 640,
  height: 360,
  marginLeft: 50,
  title: `Alpha = ${alpha.toFixed(2)}`,
  x: {label: "Component"},
  y: {label: "Weight", domain: [0, 1]},
  marks: [
    Plot.barY(dirichletWeights, {x: "component", y: "weight", fill: "#4472C4"}),
    Plot.ruleY([1 / nComponents], {stroke: "red", strokeDasharray: "4,2"})
  ]
})
```

### Dirichlet probability density (3 components)


```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof alphaTernary = Inputs.range([0.1, 20], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Concentration parameter"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Equilateral triangle vertices: v1 = p1=1, v2 = p2=1, v3 = p3=1
simplexVertices = ({
  v1: [0, 0],
  v2: [1, 0],
  v3: [0.5, Math.sqrt(3) / 2]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function cartesianToBarycentric(x, y) {
  const {v1, v2, v3} = simplexVertices;
  const denom = (v2[1] - v3[1]) * (v1[0] - v3[0]) + (v3[0] - v2[0]) * (v1[1] - v3[1]);
  const p1 = ((v2[1] - v3[1]) * (x - v3[0]) + (v3[0] - v2[0]) * (y - v3[1])) / denom;
  const p2 = ((v3[1] - v1[1]) * (x - v3[0]) + (v1[0] - v3[0]) * (y - v3[1])) / denom;
  const p3 = 1 - p1 - p2;
  return [p1, p2, p3];
}

function dirichletDensitySymmetric(p1, p2, p3, a) {
  if (p1 <= 0 || p2 <= 0 || p3 <= 0) return NaN;
  const logB = 3 * gammaLn(a) - gammaLn(3 * a);
  const logDensity = (a - 1) * (Math.log(p1) + Math.log(p2) + Math.log(p3)) - logB;
  return Math.exp(logDensity);
}

function dirichletDensityGeneral(p1, p2, p3, a1, a2, a3) {
  if (p1 <= 0 || p2 <= 0 || p3 <= 0) return NaN;
  const logB = gammaLn(a1) + gammaLn(a2) + gammaLn(a3) - gammaLn(a1 + a2 + a3);
  const logDensity = (a1 - 1) * Math.log(p1) + (a2 - 1) * Math.log(p2) + (a3 - 1) * Math.log(p3) - logB;
  return Math.exp(logDensity);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Gridlines of constant p1/p2/p3 at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 — the classic ternary-plot grid
function barycentricToCartesian(p1, p2, p3) {
  const {v1, v2, v3} = simplexVertices;
  return [
    p1 * v1[0] + p2 * v2[0] + p3 * v3[0],
    p1 * v1[1] + p2 * v2[1] + p3 * v3[1]
  ];
}

ternaryGridlines = {
  const levels = [0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8];
  const lines = [];
  for (const k of levels) {
    // constant p1 = k
    lines.push({
      group: `p1-${k}`,
      points: [barycentricToCartesian(k, 0, 1 - k), barycentricToCartesian(k, 1 - k, 0)]
    });
    // constant p2 = k
    lines.push({
      group: `p2-${k}`,
      points: [barycentricToCartesian(0, k, 1 - k), barycentricToCartesian(1 - k, k, 0)]
    });
    // constant p3 = k
    lines.push({
      group: `p3-${k}`,
      points: [barycentricToCartesian(0, 1 - k, k), barycentricToCartesian(1 - k, 0, k)]
    });
  }
  return lines.flatMap(l => l.points.map(p => ({group: l.group, x: p[0], y: p[1]})));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  width: 480,
  height: 440,
  marginLeft: 10,
  marginRight: 10,
  title: "Probability density function",
  x: {axis: null, domain: [-0.05, 1.05]},
  y: {axis: null, domain: [-0.05, Math.sqrt(3) / 2 + 0.05]},
  color: {scheme: "blues", label: "Density", legend: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.contour({
      x1: 0, x2: 1, y1: 0, y2: Math.sqrt(3) / 2,
      thresholds: 10,
      fill: (x, y) => {
        const [p1, p2, p3] = cartesianToBarycentric(x, y);
        return dirichletDensitySymmetric(p1, p2, p3, alphaTernary);
      }
    }),
    Plot.line(ternaryGridlines, {x: "x", y: "y", z: "group", stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.6, strokeOpacity: 0.6}),
    Plot.line([
      simplexVertices.v1, simplexVertices.v2, simplexVertices.v3, simplexVertices.v1
    ], {stroke: "black", strokeWidth: 1.5}),
    Plot.text(
      [
        {x: -0.03, y: -0.03, text: "p1"},
        {x: 1.03, y: -0.03, text: "p2"},
        {x: 0.5, y: Math.sqrt(3) / 2 + 0.05, text: "p3"}
      ],
      {x: "x", y: "y", text: "text", fontSize: 14}
    )
  ]
})
```

### Dirichlet density — independent alpha per component

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof alpha1 = Inputs.range([0.1, 20], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "alpha (p1)"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof alpha2 = Inputs.range([0.1, 20], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "alpha (p2)"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof alpha3 = Inputs.range([0.1, 20], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "alpha (p3)"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  width: 480,
  height: 440,
  marginLeft: 10,
  marginRight: 10,
  title: `Alpha = (${alpha1.toFixed(1)}, ${alpha2.toFixed(1)}, ${alpha3.toFixed(1)})`,
  x: {axis: null, domain: [-0.05, 1.05]},
  y: {axis: null, domain: [-0.05, Math.sqrt(3) / 2 + 0.05]},
  color: {scheme: "blues", label: "Density", legend: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.contour({
      x1: 0, x2: 1, y1: 0, y2: Math.sqrt(3) / 2,
      thresholds: 10,
      fill: (x, y) => {
        const [p1, p2, p3] = cartesianToBarycentric(x, y);
        return dirichletDensityGeneral(p1, p2, p3, alpha1, alpha2, alpha3);
      }
    }),
    Plot.line(ternaryGridlines, {x: "x", y: "y", z: "group", stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.6, strokeOpacity: 0.6}),
    Plot.line([
      simplexVertices.v1, simplexVertices.v2, simplexVertices.v3, simplexVertices.v1
    ], {stroke: "black", strokeWidth: 1.5}),
    Plot.text(
      [
        {x: -0.03, y: -0.03, text: "p1"},
        {x: 1.03, y: -0.03, text: "p2"},
        {x: 0.5, y: Math.sqrt(3) / 2 + 0.05, text: "p3"}
      ],
      {x: "x", y: "y", text: "text", fontSize: 14}
    )
  ]
})
```
